newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil net dollar inflows $323.4 mln Nov 22.
newsitem.headline: Brazil net dollar inflows $323.4 mln Nov 22.

text.p: Preliminary figures for Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a $323.4 million surplus on Nov 22 in the commercial forex market, according to Central Bank data supplied to banks.
A bank source said that at least $200 million was injected in the market on Friday ahead of the payment for shares of Rio de Janeiro power utility Cerj, which was privatized on Wednesday.
